name: ntr_territory_mapping
xsql:
SELECT * FROM $framework.NATERA_TERRITORY_MAPPING 
WHERE :v_search_territory IS NULL 
   OR :v_search_territory = ''
   OR lower(territory) LIKE lower('%' || :v_search_territory || '%')
   OR lower(category) LIKE lower('%' || :v_search_territory || '%')
   OR lower(sub_category) LIKE lower('%' || :v_search_territory || '%');
